text:
maya: heads up — ACME (private prod-eu) hitting 401 on debug bundle upload to our presign endpoint. Customer supplied request id req_93b4f and a short error: "InvalidAccessKeyId". Can collectors team help gather repro + redacted bundle?

leo: thanks. region? env tag? 401 vs 403 gives different signals.

maya: region eu-west-1, env prod-eu, collector version 2.14. They say upload attempt returned 401 from s3 endpoint.

sam: possible creds rotation or presign signed with wrong key. Did customer use collector bootstrap that pulled credentials from instance metadata or our presign service?

maya: they used our collector binary with `--upload --presign` flow. I asked for the exact curl they ran; customer replied with this repro snippet: 
```
curl -v -X PUT "https://redwood-presign-eu.s3.amazonaws.com/abcd?X-Amz-Signature=..." \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-tar" \ 
  --data-binary @debug-bundle.tar.gz
```
Their client log shows: `403 Forbidden` in one line but our gateway shows `401 InvalidAccessKeyId` for the same req_93b4f.

ana: collector-bot, can you attach the collector bootstrap + upload logs for that request id from the prod-eu pool?

collector-bot: attached logs for req_93b4f (truncated) — 
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:33Z] collector: bootstrapped using instance role
[2026-03-15T10:12:35Z] collector: fetched presign url from control-plane: https://redwood-presign-eu.s3.amazonaws.com/abcd?X-Amz-Signature=...
[2026-03-15T10:12:37Z] uploader: PUT -> 403 Forbidden 
[2026-03-15T10:12:37Z] uploader: response body: {"message":"InvalidAccessKeyId"}
```

leo: two quick checks: 1) presign URL region mismatch (signed for us-east, used eu-west) results in signature failure. 2) If KMS key policy rotated on presign bucket, presigned URL may still work but S3 might reject. Can support ask customer to run `curl -I` on the presign url and capture headers?

maya: requested `curl -I` and full verbose oauth header capture. Also asked them to run collector with `--collect-debug --no-upload` so we can get a local bundle to inspect redaction config.

sam: share the minimal command for them: 
```
./collector --collect-debug --no-upload --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.yml --out debug-bundle.tar.gz
# then: sha256sum debug-bundle.tar.gz; base64 head -c 256 debug-bundle.tar.gz | base64 -w0
```
This helps us verify the bundle and avoid sending PII.

maya: customer sent the local bundle fingerprint and a redaction file. Their redact.yml excludes ip_address and headers.x-forwarded-for — that matches their privacy needs but breaks request tracing. We asked them to temporarily enable `trace-headers: true` in a copy of the config and rerun with `--no-upload`.

ana: while we have them, if upload still fails have them upload the debug bundle to a customer S3 we can access via a one-time presign (we can generate as support). If private network blocks outbound, fallback is SFTP to our secure intake box — instructions: `scp debug-bundle.tar.gz redwood-intake@intake.redwood.example:/incoming/ACME/` (we'll provide one-time creds).

maya: followup: customer ran `curl -I` and it returned a `Host: redwood-presign-eu.s3.amazonaws.com` header but the presign signature contains `X-Amz-Credential=AKIA.../20260315/us-east-1/s3/aws4_request` — so presign was minted for us-east-1 but used against eu-west-1 endpoint. That explains the InvalidAccessKeyId. I told them to retry with the region-corrected presign URL.

sam: ok great. For mitigation we should: 1) add a validation in control-plane that rejects issuing presign URLs with wrong region for private deployments, 2) update collector to detect region mismatch and surface clearer error ("presign-region-mismatch"). Filing internal ticket ENG-9802.

leo: for the debug bundle redaction mismatch we should provide a small helper to preview redaction locally: `./collector redaction-preview /path/to/redact.yml debug-bundle.tar.gz` — filing DOCS ticket to add this snippet to KB.

maya: customer retried with new presign and upload succeeded. They still shared the local debug bundle (redacted) for our analysis. Closing the thread once we finish a quick root-cause note. :tada:

sam: nice. saved by region check. small ops note: watch presign issuer during key rotations.

maya: marking resolved for support; will add follow-ups in the ticket: presign region validation + collector error string.
